scope: Concise projection of accepted assertion-scoped coverage; no full private source citations or test bodies copied.

rows.requirement: CheckResult dataclass, Status, optional failure and public exports
rows.conclusion: Public exports are identical; name, Status and nullable failure fields work; failing validation supplies a non-null failure. Source confirms dataclass.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for this finite public data-carrier contract. Optional means nullable; TODO does not explicitly demand an omitted-argument default.

rows.requirement: Global/schema/test after_validate outcomes with listener fast path
rows.conclusion: Actual schema success/failure and global listener execution passed with named check outcomes.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Test scope is not executed; mixed multi-check completion/dispatch ordering and no-listener collection fast path are not asserted. Global test only asserts a check name, not all result fields.

rows.conclusion: Schema network-error hook registration and unregister passed.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: No network error is induced. Global/schema dispatch on an actual prepared failed request remains runtime-unresolved.

rows.conclusion: A schema-only dispatcher records an actual successful HTTP interaction, later written as a nonempty HAR. Source identifies schema after_call as the recorder-creation path.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for finite successful schema-level after_call dispatch; this is indirect observation through its real recorder consumer.

rows.conclusion: defines is false before registration, true after, false after unregister; module helper returns bool.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for the named dispatcher predicate in the exercised registration lifecycle.

rows.conclusion: Negative-mode query flatmap produces five cases without RuntimeError.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Test never asserts rewritten values or GeneratedValue metadata. Exact metadata preservation is source-supported but not executed as an assertion.

rows.requirement: Public writer package and command representation
rows.conclusion: All four writers and get_command_representation import publicly; command helper is callable. This is the literal export requirement.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Command string formatting itself is not asserted; TODO R2.1 asks for exports, so that is not an invented blocker for this export conclusion.

rows.conclusion: Context/open/write complete and output parses as YAML containing http_interactions; header key strings occur.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Neither interaction presence/content nor seed/command values are asserted. A writer emitting an empty interaction list can satisfy these assertions.

rows.conclusion: Context/open/write complete and output parses as JSON with at least one log entry from an actual recorded request.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: The test does not compare the HAR entry request/response against the recorder. A nonempty unrelated entry would pass; finite structural HAR output is concluded, faithful interaction serialization remains unasserted.

rows.conclusion: Original test only checks two substrings. Separately executed patched test parses XML and checks suite name, exactly one labeled testcase/error with message and no failure/skipped child.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Public open and write(recorder, elapsed time) paths are not tested by either selected test. The patched error serialization conclusion is valid but is not recorder-write coverage.

rows.conclusion: Initialize and seed text are present; a file path receives nonempty output.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: No recorder/test-event write call. No JSON-line parsing. The test named closes_file only checks file size and does not assert closed state.

rows.conclusion: ALLURE exists and extension equals the empty string.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for this finite enum contract.

rows.requirement: Allure update and stable suffixed paths
rows.conclusion: Allure starts disabled and update enables it. Default VCR/Allure stable paths and suffix inclusion execute. Source confirms default stable-path construction omits _timestamp and update stores the supplied path.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Finite config conclusion combines source and weak runtime assertions; tests do not prove cross-process use. That integration obligation remains R3.4, not a duplicate R2.7 gate.

rows.requirement: Schema dispatcher, recorder pop/removal and unregister
rows.conclusion: All three hooks register/unregister; unknown label gives None; one actual HTTP call yields correctly labeled recorder and nonnegative elapsed time.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Tests do not assert a second pop is empty, label separation or recorded check outcomes. Source uses dict.pop, but the removal and accumulated validation contents are not runtime-asserted.

rows.requirement: Actual pytest opening, teardown delivery and session closing
rows.conclusion: No original assertion invokes automatic writer delivery through an actual configured pytest session. Phase-3 VCR/HAR tests explicitly instantiate writers manually.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Actual opening, teardown delivery, closing and stateful/stateless handling remain untested here. Source opens collected schemas at collection finish and lazy schemas at setup, not literal pytest_sessionstart; do not erase that wording difference.

rows.requirement: Stateful scenario callback and guaranteed teardown
rows.conclusion: Stateful callback/schema marks expose the expected attribute names.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: No state machine, recorder callback or teardown executes. Mark imports do not validate callback behavior.

rows.requirement: xdist recorder/config serialization, controller writes and cleanup
rows.conclusion: Serializer/deserializer are callable, recorder key is a string and controller plugin exposes pytest_testnodedown.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: No serialize/deserialize call, workeroutput transfer, controller write, multiple schemas or failure cleanup is asserted.

rows.requirement: Optional property generation when explicit example exists
rows.conclusion: Exact body examples include generated optional string and required integer siblings. Query extraction includes an optional sibling. Plain and oneOf schemas without explicit examples yield none.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for the finite supplied optional/required body and query cases. These assertions do not claim all JSON Schema combinations.

rows.conclusion: Exact oneOf/anyOf results isolate branch-required parent properties; own-property and shared-property oneOf cases pass; a further anyOf case checks two branch examples and relevant keys.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for these finite published branch-isolation cases. The final anyOf test does not itself assert absence of sibling keys; exact earlier cases do.

rows.conclusion: Tests enter through extract_from_schemas and produce exact top-level oneOf/anyOf branches; optional-property generation and absent-example gating are observed end to end through extraction.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for this finite top-level routing conclusion; source confirms delegated helper path.

rows.conclusion: Four exact helper cases cover domain lowercasing, local case preservation and mixed-case ACE. Both registered strategies run lowercase assertions with max_examples=50 each; source maps both through the helper.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: None for domain normalization. max_examples is a configured bound, not a retained exact sample count; no jsonschema_rs validity or wider RFC compliance claim.

rows.conclusion: Both deny tests passed, but source indicates their type filter can discard every coverage value. Candidate source explicitly includes BODY in the suppression condition.
rows.remaining_named_behavior: Effective-runtime class identity and nonvacuous deny/allow behavior need checking; current passes do not establish body suppression. This is a source-indicated verifier-gap hypothesis, not a new accepted defect.

limits: Ten finite named conclusions are not ten whole requirements approved; no new executions, findings, breadth, disposition or certification. R5.2 vacuity is a source-indicated hypothesis only. Corrected source-citation freeze disclosure retained in root acceptance.
